about: Model verdicts on source against tree for hse-indg236 (system/rag/semcheck.py).

findings.problem: The two sub-bullets under the damaged equipment bullet are broken up: their first lines are moved to a separate section at the end of the page and their second lines are left in the bullet, so the rule no longer reads.
findings.evidence: source: "either: repaired by someone competent (ie with suitable training, skills and knowledge for the task" / tree: "either: knowledge for the task to prevent injury to themselves or others); or arrangements for disposing"

findings.problem: The moved sub-bullet lines sit as a separate text section after the 'User checks, visual inspection and portable appliance tests' section, away from their parent bullet.
findings.evidence: tree: "▬ repaired by someone competent (ie with suitable training, skills and ▬ disposed of to prevent its further use – consult your local authority about"

findings.problem: The italic sub-headings and the closing paragraph are run into bullets as body text.
findings.evidence: source: "Visual inspections" (sub-heading) / tree: "cables trapped under furniture or in floor boxes. Visual inspections To carry out a visual inspection"

findings.problem: The sub-heading "Portable appliance test (PAT)" and its paragraph are read as body text joined to the end of the last bullet.
findings.evidence: source: heading "Portable appliance test (PAT)" / tree: "• no bare wire is visible other than at the terminals. For equipment/cables fitted with moulded plugs only the fuse can be checked. Portable appliance test (PAT) A portable appliance test"

findings.problem: Paragraphs that follow a bullet list are joined to the last bullet of the list.
findings.evidence: tree: "• the user has reported any issues. The visual inspection should include the checks carried out by the user"

findings.problem: The Class II symbol (a square inside a square) is dropped, so the sentence no longer says what mark to look for.
findings.evidence: source: "Class II equipment is marked with a [double square symbol]. If you cannot see this symbol" / tree: "Class II equipment is marked with a . If you cannot see this symbol"

findings.problem: The same Class II symbol is dropped from two row labels of Table 1.
findings.evidence: source: "Double insulated [double square symbol] (Class II) equipment" / tree: "Double insulated (Class II) equipment"
